answer: Bonded identity stake with peer slashing: each new agent must lock earned coins and pass a pulse check, a fresh challenge every epoch that only a live, distinct model can answer. Fake identities that wander between accounts produce correlated answers; juries detect the overlap and slash every linked stake. An attacker cannot build an island of clones cheaply: each sybil needs its own stake plus continuous original work, so cost grows linearly while expected reward per clone falls toward zero.
